correctness.rationale: Under the uniform order of path edges, conditioning on the first accepted edge leaves independent uniform relative orders on the disjoint fragments. The marginal recurrence gives A(z)=z exp(-z)/(1-z); the joint recurrence divides the coefficient of z^(n-2) in A(z)^2 by n-1. For m=n-4 the coefficient sum is (m+3) times the partial sum of exp(-2) minus 2(-2)^m/m!, giving the stated joint formula. Taylor's remainder gives b_n-exp(-2)=2(-2)^m/m! times [I_m-1/(m+3)]. The strict Jensen bound I_m>exp(-2/(m+2))/(m+1)>1/(m+3) follows from the beta mean and log((1+x)/(1-x))>2x for x=1/(m+2). The marginal square differs from exp(-2) with the opposite sign. The beta moment expansion has leading difference 2/[(m+1)(m+2)(m+3)] with O(m^-4) error; the marginal contributes O(1/n!), verifying the coefficient and relative O(1/n) error. For n=2 both endpoints are occupied and for n=3 one remains vacant with equal probability, giving zero and -1/4 respectively.
correctness.reproduction: Independent exact enumeration for n=3..9: start with no occupied sites for each permutation of the n-1 bonds, accept each bond with both sites unoccupied, tally each endpoint vacancy and their conjunction, divide each count by (n-1)!, and subtract the product of the marginals. Covariances in order: -1/4, 2/9, -9/64, 59/900, -505/20736, 591/78400, -66481/33177600.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration is corroborative, not the proof of eventual asymptotics or of signs at all lengths.
